fruit_description: Flat, oak-shaped leaves with purple-red veins and stems
flavor_profile: Mild, sweet flavor - sweetens noticeably after frost
special_characteristics: Beautiful variety with flat, oak-shaped leaves featuring striking purple-red veins. Tender texture makes it excellent for raw eating. Sweetens noticeably after frost. One of the most cold-hardy kale varieties - outlasts others into early spring. Very mild flavor compared to other kales. Fast-growing at 55 days. Recommended for Central Texas gardens.
